# v0.5.8 multi-category validation fixtures

These fixtures stress the same runtime across materially different commerce categories instead of validating only beauty.

- `beauty_kiyuu.json`: KIYUU K01 facts from the user's project sources.
- `fashion_uniqlo_bag.json`: UNIQLO Round Mini Shoulder Bag facts captured from the official US product page on 2026-10-27.
- `home_ikea365_container.json`: IKEA 365+ 34 oz rectangular glass/plastic food-container facts captured from IKEA's official US IKEA 365+ food-storage pages on 2026-10-27.

The non-KIYUU fixtures are validation inputs, not assertions that those brands currently sell those exact items through TikTok Shop Malaysia. The target channel is intentionally held constant to stress category-specific strategy and asset reasoning while keeping platform effects comparable.
